changes: place.normalized cleared: 'Rāmanagara' is a common toponym (e.g. Ramnagar opposite Vārāṇasī, or several in Nepal/Tarai), so the identification is not certain; possibilities noted in notes
purpose changed from 'svārtha' (not stated) to a description of the ownership statement
notes expanded on 'mamaḥ' and the place

purpose: ownership: pustakam idaṃ hariharaśarmaṇaḥ (scribe's own copy)
notes: 'śrīhariharapaṃḍito mamaḥ (!)' is probably a corruption of 'śrīhariharapaṇḍitena mama' ('[written] by me, Harihara Paṇḍita') or contains a stray 'namaḥ'. 'pustakīyaṃ (!) hariharasarmaṇoḥ (!)' should be read as 'pustakam idaṃ hariharaśarmaṇaḥ', so the same Harihara is both scribe and owner. 'mukāma' (Hindi/Persian for 'halting place, residence') points to a North Indian or Tarai setting. Rāmanagara could be Ramnagar near Vārāṇasī or one of several places of that name, so it is left unnormalized. ŚS 1711 + 78 = CE 1789 (Kārttika ≈ Oct/Nov 1789). The weekday has not been verified. Nothing conflicts with the catalogue fields.
